name: financials_list_financial_transaction_services
description:
Catalogs the SERVICES (fee/charge line types) observed in a company's Amazon financial transactions (neonpanel_iceberg.financial_transaction_lines_v1).

A SERVICE is one classification key (match_key): the verbatim Amazon breakdownType leaf from the fee breakdown tree (e.g. OurPricePrincipal, Commission, FBAStorageFee), a composite '<type>:<description>' key for context-dependent leaves (e.g. Base:AWDTransportationFee, FBADisposalFee:legacy), or 'TXN:<transactionType>' for transactions that carry no breakdowns (e.g. TXN:Transfer).

Each returned row includes: service_key, line_kind (breakdown leaf vs transaction-level), origin_transaction_types + origin_descriptions (which Amazon transactions produce it), first/last month active, line & transaction counts, signs seen, the summary class/subclass each sign maps to, an is_unclassified flag, and a plain-language EXPLANATION of how the service arises from Amazon transaction data.

Use cases: understanding what a fee is, auditing which services occur in a company's data, and finding unclassified (unmapped) services (filters.only_unclassified=true). Amounts are intentionally NOT returned -- use financials_analyze_financial_transactions for money. Use financials_list_financial_transaction_class_map for the full classification rulebook.

Knowledge base: https://help.neonpanel.com

report_months.description: Optional YYYY-MM months to restrict the catalog to (marketplace-local months).

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on service_key.

only_unclassified.description: When true, return only services with at least one observed sign lacking a class-map rule.

filters.description: Compatibility alias for query.filters. Prefer query.filters.

limit.description: Compatibility alias for query.limit. Prefer query.limit.
